question: Provide a brief overview of your company including year founded and number of employees.
Who is accountable for information security within your organisation and to whom do they report?
Describe your financial position and confirm whether you have any outstanding debt or pending litigation.
Do you hold ISO/IEC 27001 certification? Provide certificate number and scope.
Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report? State the audit period and any exceptions noted.
Do you hold TISAX assessment results?
Are you PCI DSS compliant or do you process cardholder data on our behalf?
Do you hold any other certifications or attestations (e.g. Cyber Essentials Plus or ISO 27017/27018)?
Have you experienced any security incidents or data breaches in the last 36 months? Provide details, including root cause and remediation.
Describe how customer data is encrypted at rest including algorithms and key management.
Describe how data is encrypted in transit and which TLS versions are supported.
Do you use FIPS 140-2 validated cryptographic modules for encryption of customer data?
Can customers bring their own encryption keys (BYOK) or manage their own keys (CMK)?
How is customer data logically segregated from other tenants?
In which geographic regions is our data stored and processed? Can we restrict processing to the EU?
How are secrets and credentials (e.g. API keys and database passwords) stored and rotated?
Do you support single sign-on via SAML 2.0 or OIDC and automated provisioning via SCIM?
Is multi-factor authentication enforced for your employees and available for customers?
Describe your role-based access control model within the product.
How is privileged access to production systems controlled and monitored?
How often are access rights reviewed and how quickly is access revoked upon termination?
Are shared or generic accounts used in any environment?
Describe your hosting environment including cloud provider and regions used.
Describe network segmentation and controls protecting production systems.
What web application firewall and DDoS protection do you use?
Do you have intrusion detection or prevention systems in place?
Can access to your service be restricted to specific IP addresses?
Describe your secure software development lifecycle including code review and CI security gates.
What is your vulnerability management process and what are your remediation SLAs by severity?
When was your last third-party penetration test and what were the results? Can the report be shared?
Describe your change management process including approval for high-risk changes and rollback capability.
Do you offer source code escrow?
Do you have a documented incident response plan and how often is it tested?
Within what timeframe will you notify us of a security incident affecting our data?
What are your RPO and RTO targets and when were they last tested?
Describe your backup strategy including frequency and retention and encryption.
Do you have a business continuity plan covering loss of key personnel and premises and suppliers?
Describe your logging and monitoring capabilities and log retention period.
Have you appointed a Data Protection Officer? Provide contact details.
Do you provide a GDPR-compliant Data Processing Agreement including Standard Contractual Clauses?
List all subprocessors that will have access to our data and their locations.
How will we be notified of changes to your subprocessors and can we object?
How is customer data deleted upon termination and within what timeframe?
Do you use customer data for any secondary purposes including analytics or model training?
Will you accept unlimited liability for data breaches?
Describe the indemnification you provide including for IP infringement and data breaches.
Do we have the right to audit your security controls and how frequently?
What insurance coverage do you maintain (cyber liability and professional indemnity) and with what limits?
Do you use artificial intelligence or machine learning in your service? Describe the models used and where they are hosted.
Can AI features be disabled for our tenant and how are AI inputs and outputs logged and retained?
